decision_basis: Two independent Docker canonical-build cycles produced the same zte_tpd.ko SHA-256.
Candidate and stock AArch64 assembly have identical 13 instructions, 52-byte symbol size and resolved relocations.
Candidate and stock KCFI type IDs are identical: 0x24a11bb9.
Strict Joern gate passed with zero parse problems and one-to-one source/Ghidra identity coverage.
The dedicated ASAN/UBSAN contract passed 3/3 cases in both reproducible cycles, covering log arguments and exactly one teardown call.
